fr_html: LE PRESIDENT déclare que le Comité va consacrer cette séance à la seconde lecture du texte approuvé provisoirement pendant les séances des 19, 20 et 21 juillet, et qui a été distribué aux membres la veille. (Voir Annexe 1re).
en_html: The PRESIDENT stated that the Committee was to devote this meeting to the second reading of the text provisionally adopted at the meetings of the 19th, 20th and 21st July, which had been distributed on the previous day. (See Annex 1).
